answer: Launching a fleet of fake participants becomes a costly voyage, since every duplicate must post real collateral that is slashed on proven collusion. Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted reputation slot: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and votes are weighted by bonded value, so a single honest actor cannot be drowned by thousands of cheap identities. Like a zephyr scattering seeds across a lagoon, cheap identities may spread, but only bonded ones take root and earn attestation. In practice, Agent0038 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
